# MIC ORM

> A .NET 10 ORM in which an entity is a C# interface, the implementing class is emitted at startup, and the
> database is derived from the model on every connect: no migrations, no entity classes. PostgreSQL, SQL Server,
> MySQL, Oracle, SQLite and Db2 from one model. Not Entity Framework: no DbContext, no DbSet, no data annotations.

## Guide

- [Overview](guide/overview.html): a full-featured .NET ORM, part of the MIC framework, the successor of VITA.
- [Simple application](guide/simple-application.html): one program with the model, the module, the application,
  the startup, a save and a query.
- [Feature highlights](guide/highlights.html): the features in short: entities as interfaces, modules, tracking,
  saves, LINQ, servers, the data and query caches, full-text, JSON, schema maintenance, database objects,
  database first, QueryMaker, smart loading, application extensions.

## Using MIC ORM

- [Getting started](guide/getting-started.html): `dotnet new mic-app`, pointing it at a database, running it,
  editing the data model.
- [Application data model](guide/data-model.html): an entity is an interface, modules and the application,
  database-agnostic, database first.
- [Entity members and types](guide/entity-members.html): member types and column types, nullability and size,
  the column type set explicitly with `[Column]`, the primary key, reference members, list members,
  `IQueryable<T>` members, generated values, computed members.
- [Application startup](guide/startup.html): the startup sequence, `Init`, `ConnectToAsync`, the connected
  application a singleton, `DbSettings`, the connection string, startup errors, the shutdown.
- [Core runtime objects](guide/core-objects.html): `OperationContext`,
  `EntitySession`, entity tracking.
- [Reading data](guide/linq-queries.html): loading by primary key, stubs, lazy loading of related entities, LINQ
  queries, `QueryOptions`, the N+1 problem, `Include`.
- [Updating data](guide/saving-changes.html): changing entities, `ClientFault`, `SaveChanges`, transactions, set-based
  updates in LINQ, scheduled statements.

## Advanced features

- [Database objects](guide/database-objects.html): indexes, views, sequences, table-valued functions, computed
  columns.
- [Maintaining the database schema](guide/database-model.html): scripts and migrations, or the schema derived
  from the C# model; what a connect does; the `DbInfo` table.
- [Temp tables](guide/temp-tables.html): a list of values as an entity the session fills and joins.
- [JSON](guide/json.html): `[Json]` members, typed documents, `[FromJson]` columns.
- [Full-text search](guide/full-text.html): the full-text index, `FullText.Matches` and `FullText.Rank`.
- [Geographic points](guide/geo-points.html): `GeoPoint` members, the spatial index, `GeoFunctions.Distance`.
- [Vector search](guide/vector-search.html): `[Vector]` members for embeddings, `VectorFunctions.Distance`, the
  vector index, on PostgreSQL with pgvector and SQL Server 2025.
- [Data cache](guide/data-cache.html): cached entities, the queries answered in memory.
- [QueryMaker](guide/querymaker.html): a query composed at run time from names.
- [Direct SQL](guide/direct-sql.html): SQL text run through the session.
- [Locking records](guide/locking.html): `WriteLock`, `LockForUpdate`, snapshot reads, `[RowVersion]`.
- [Smart loading](guide/smart-loading.html): the smart lazy load, where `Include` fits and where it does not,
  the three hooks (a reference, a list member, a query over an `IQueryable<T>` member), the bounds,
  `DisableSmartLoad`.
- [On-demand members](guide/on-demand-members.html): `[OnDemand]` on a large column member, left out of every
  read of its entity and loaded on the first read; `Include` and `LoadMemberAsync` to load it ahead of the read.
- [Guid generation](guide/guid-generation.html): Guid keys made in the application and ordered by time, the
  versions, the time read out of a key with `EntityHelper.GetTimestamp`, SQL Server's layout, `GuidScheme`.
- [Logging](guide/logging.html): the operation's log and its modes, the file log for development, `ILogListener`
  for production.
- [C# attributes for modeling](guide/attributes.html): the attributes used most, each with an example.

## Application extensions

- [About application extensions](guide/app-extensions.html): a cross-cutting rule as one class; filters on every
  read, handlers on the save.
- [Multi-tenancy extension](guide/multi-tenancy.html): `ITenant` and `ITenantBound`, `TenantMemberName` and
  `[TenantId]` for an existing database, the tenant from the context; tenants across databases, a composite
  tenant key, a database added at run time through `DatabaseEvents.DatabaseMissing`.
- [Soft delete extension](guide/soft-delete.html): `ISoftDeleteEntity`, `DeletedMemberName` and `[DeletedMark]` for
  an existing database, a delete that writes the mark.

## Servers and hosting

- [Database server specifics](guide/servers.html): what differs between the servers: the Guid scheme, unlimited
  text and binary on MySQL, binary members on Oracle, an `int` key on SQLite, the SQLite driver.
- [MIC ORM on an existing Db2 database](guide/existing-db2-database.html): the packages, the model generated from
  the database, the connect under `DbUpgradeMode.Never`, reading and updating, the limits on Db2.
- [Array columns on PostgreSQL](guide/postgres-arrays.html): a member typed `T[]` or `List<T>` as an array
  column, the item types, reading and writing, queries over the items, the other servers.
- [Setup in ASP.NET Core](guide/aspnet-core.html): the application a singleton, an `OperationContext` per
  request as a scoped service.

## Reference

- [Generating entities from a database](guide/tool-entities.html): `mic-db entities`, database first.
- [Generating the upgrade script](guide/tool-upgrade.html): `mic-db upgrade`, the DDL for review.
- [How to…](guide/how-to.html): quick answers, one question per heading.
- [Running tests](guide/running-tests.html): the suites, the servers in Docker, `MIC_TEST_VENDORS`, run times,
  the SQL log.
- [Advanced example - Beauty Shop](guide/beauty-shop.html): the multi-tenant example application and its source.
- [Migrating from VITA](guide/migrating-from-vita.html): what changed, what is new, the steps.
